name: Icebound
weather: ground blizzard with drifting artillery smoke
designIntent: Defend Compact engineers crossing a glacier under sustained artillery fire; the bridging span collapses and Commander Ekene is captured alive covering the retreat — the campaign's gut-punch.

briefing.speaker: Ekene
briefing.text: Listen close, because the window's short. The Directorate pulled their mag-line security east, which means for about six hours the Sarn Glacier is the only road between us and Rauk's polar network. Our engineers are taking a bridging column across tonight — portable spans, thumper charges, everything we need to cut her supply lines for good. Problem: Rauk knows the glacier is the only road too. Her batteries at Station Nadir can range the whole crossing, and she will walk fire onto anything that moves. Your job is simple and ugly. Screen the column. Kill her spotters before they call corrections. If a span goes down, you hold the crevasse line until the engineers re-rig. I'll be on the ice with you in the Corundum — I'm done watching this one from a map table. Weather's foul, footing's worse. Keep your throttle honest and your heat low. We cross together, Lodestar. All of us.

objectives.title: Screen the Column
objectives.description: Escort the engineer bridging column across the Sarn Glacier crossing.

objectives.title: Silence the Spotters
objectives.description: Destroy the three artillery spotter teams before they can walk fire onto the column.

objectives.title: Hold the Crevasse Line
objectives.description: Defend the engineers while they re-rig the collapsed bridging span.

objectives.title: Fall Back
objectives.description: Reach Rally Point Cairn-9 through the icefall while Commander Ekene covers the withdrawal.

objectives.title: Nadir Relay
objectives.description: Destroy the counter-battery uplink mast to degrade artillery accuracy for the rest of the mission.

enemyForces: Off-map artillery batteries at Station Nadir delivering walking barrages
Hover skiff spotter teams marking the column for corrections
Tracked Ferric APC platoons deploying infantry across the ice
Halite brawler pair holding the ice picket line
Basalt heavy pair anchoring the moraine chokepoint
Strafing aircraft passes during the final withdrawal
setPieces: Commander Ekene fights alongside the player in her Corundum for the first and only time
Walking artillery barrages crater the glacier in real time, opening crevasses that reroute the crossing
The main bridging span collapses mid-crossing, dropping a Ferric APC into the dark
Final withdrawal: Ekene's Corundum stands alone at the moraine gap, covering the retreat until her mech is legged and swarmed
Capture scene: Directorate recovery skiffs lift the downed Corundum away as the storm closes in, while CAIRN confirms her transponder is still alive
failConditions: The engineer bridging column is destroyed (fewer than two span carriers survive)
Rally Point Cairn-9 is not reached before the barrage saturates the icefall
salvageNotes: Poor field salvage by design: the glacier swallows most wrecks and the withdrawal leaves no time to strip the rest. Spotter skiffs killed cleanly before the collapse yield sensor components; the Basalt pair at the moraine give up autocannon parts only if legged. Nothing left on the far ice can ever be recovered.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Core ignition confirmed. Actuator lattice — green. Weapon buses — live. Coolant loop pressurized. All boards answer ready. Good hunting, Lodestar.

voTriggers.speaker: Ekene
voTriggers.line: Corundum on your left flank, Lodestar. Tonight you get to see how the old chassis dances. Column's moving — eyes up.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Spotter uplink just lit up, grid two-two. Kill the callers before the guns learn our names.

voTriggers.speaker: Sable
voTriggers.line: Spotter down. They're blind on this axis.

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: APCs on the ice! Ha — come on then, let's see who slips first!

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Ballistic arcs inbound. Impact pattern advancing along the column's route.

voTriggers.speaker: Vireo
voTriggers.line: The span — the span's gone! They're in the crevasse — oh no, no —

voTriggers.speaker: Ekene
voTriggers.line: Engineers, re-rig on the south lip. Everyone else, you are a wall. Nothing crosses that ice.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Structural integrity failing. Recommend disengaging to the smoke line.

voTriggers.speaker: Ekene
voTriggers.line: Column's across. Fireteam, fall back to Cairn-nine. I'll hold the gap. That is not a request, Lodestar — move.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Anchor's hit — her leg's gone — she's down, she's down! Transponder still green — they're... Directorate skiffs are on her. They're taking her. They're taking her alive.

voTriggers.speaker: Tremor
voTriggers.line: Turn around. We turn around NOW — Relay, give me one reason we don't turn around!

voTriggers.speaker: Sable
voTriggers.line: Tremor. She said move. So we move. And then we get her back.

voTriggers.speaker: CAIRN
voTriggers.line: Corundum transponder active. Signal bearing north-northeast, receding. Logging for recovery, Lodestar. This entry stays open.

voTriggers.speaker: Relay
voTriggers.line: Cairn-nine, all surviving callsigns accounted... all but one. Mission's done. I'll write it up. Get some rest. That's... that's what she'd say.
